string.name: suggestions_section_empty
string.description: Text of a card explaining to the user that they can expect to see suggested articles in this area in the future.

string.name: snackbar_fetch_failed
string.description: Snackbar text shown when the user presses the More button to get more suggested articles, but this fails (eg, no internet connectivity).

string.name: snackbar_fetch_no_new_suggestions
string.description: Snackbar text shown when the user presses the More button to get more suggested articles, the fetch succeeds but provides no new suggestions.
